vulnerability.name: GO-2026-5932
vulnerability.description: golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp is unmaintained and unsafe by design

statements.impact_statement: Docker Compose in the container image requires golang.org/x/crypto, but does not import the openpgp packages: the binary contains no openpgp symbols, and govulncheck -mode binary, run on every CI build, finds no called vulnerable code.
